# Star filter

Turns highlights into stars with two, three or more crossing streaks, like a star filter screwed onto a lens.

<EffectDemo effect="star-streaks" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { starStreaks } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/star-streaks';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(starStreaks({ preset: 'cross' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 1`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type    | Default | Range      | Description                                                     |
| ----------- | ------- | ------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity` | number  | `1`     | 0 – 4      | Brightness of the streaks.                                      |
| `threshold` | number  | `1.2`   | 0 – 8      | Linear brightness above which lights make stars.                |
| `lines`     | integer | `2`     | 1 – 6      | Lines through each star: 2 makes a cross, 3 a six-pointed star. |
| `angle`     | number  | `25`    | 0 – 180 °  | Rotation of the star.                                           |
| `length`    | number  | `0.9`   | 0.5 – 0.98 | How slowly the streaks fade: higher values make longer rays.    |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                     |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `cross`    | `lines: 2`, `angle: 45`                      |
| `sixPoint` | `lines: 3`, `angle: 0`, `intensity: 1.3`     |
| `sparkle`  | `lines: 4`, `length: 0.85`, `threshold: 0.9` |
| `long`     | `length: 0.96`, `intensity: 0.8`             |

Apply one with `starStreaks({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Blur & glow · tracked as story X5.9 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/star-streaks`, including the shared effect runtime.

Original implementation (MIT). References: Kawase, Frame buffer postprocessing effects in DOUBLE-S.T.E.A.L, GDC 2003 (star filter with growing steps).
